blocks.text: Quantum Theory assumes the behaviour of electromagnetic radiations as discrete packets of energy and particles on a very small scale to behave as waves. It is probably the most successful theory in physics at providing explanations for the unresolved issues and accurate predictions.
However, the classical physics is still valid in ordinary processes of everyday life. We shall discuss various aspects of quantum theory in this chapter.
